newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - United International cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - United International cut.

text.p: -- Lazard Freres analyst Alfredo Jollon said he had cut his rating on United International Holdings Inc to hold from speculative buy.

-- In a January 16 report, Jollon said he had changed his rating for the cable holding company because it had postponed a $100 million initial public offering and a $150 million debt offering for its Asia/Pacific unit. The company also has interests in Latin America.
-- The company's shares were off 1/2 to 11-1/4 at midday.
